params.overview: Two physical Apple Silicon Macs run one DS4 model as a tensor-parallel pair.
params.rationale: Tensor parallelism: dense+shared weights replicated on both; routed experts split 50/50; partial sums at 2 gates/layer; leader samples; per-node KV persisted.

components.name: leader Mac (rank 0)
components.overview: The first physical Apple Silicon Mac. Owns the HTTP server, the prompt + sampling on the final logits, and one half of the resident routed experts; dense/shared weights are replicated.

semantics.value: leader owns serving + sampling + half experts

components.name: worker Mac (rank 1)
components.overview: The second identical Apple Silicon Mac. Dials the leader, mirrors every session sync/eval, and keeps the other half of routed experts resident; computes its share then gate-exchanges partial sums.

semantics.value: worker mirrors decode with partner expert half

components.name: Metal inference engine (per node)
components.overview: On each node: the DS4 Metal engine holds the graph, weights (replicated dense + own expert half), and per-session KV. Runs layer graphs: attention, MoE FFN, norm, output head.

components.name: disk KV cache (per node)
components.overview: Per-node disk KV store: entries keyed by prompt-text sha with tokens/ctx/budget; live prefix reconciled and persisted under eviction.

components.name: sampler (leader only)
components.overview: After the TP pair merge the vocab-split logits, the leader samples the next token.

components.name: TP gate transport (both nodes)
components.overview: Full-duplex RDMA/TCP links used to exchange per-layer attention and FFN partial sums and the logits half; two gates per layer (ATTN, FFN).

connections.label: sampler feeds next token to decode
leader persists KV to disk cache

semantics.value: two physical nodes + shared TP transport + per-node components
